lines.en: I walk on my knuckles
A huge hand drags across the ground

lines.zh: 我的手指一根根落下去
lines.en: My fingers drop one by one
I float forward
I slide along on my palm
My five finger bones splay out
I crawl over the stones
I creep your way
My knuckles scrape the earth
I move slowly and steadily

lines.zh: 我悬着，五根手指微微弯
lines.en: I hover, fingers slightly curled
My palm bones hold still
I clench at nothing
My fingers close one by one
A dull knock comes from the joints
I turn my palm over slowly
I hang half a block up
I hover, waiting for you
My finger bones tap together
I lift and settle
No skin here, only bone
I spread my fingers slowly
My palm lines are all seams

lines.zh: 五根指骨张着，悬着不动。
lines.en: Five finger bones hang open and still.
I grasp a fistful of air
I rub my fingertips on the stone
My five fingers open toward you
You are smaller than my palm

lines.zh: 我悬在你头顶，指节慢慢收拢。
lines.en: I hang over your head, knuckles slowly closing.
My finger bones close slowly
I drop my wrist to see you
You stand exactly right
I turn my palm to you
I reach out to grab you
You took half a step back
My fingers are still spread
Soil shows between my fingers
I slowly spread my fingers
One of my fingers draws back
Bone dust falls from my wrist
My palm rocks aside
That one had some force
I gather my fingers again
I return to my old height
Bones like mine know no pain
I keep that blow in the bone
My joints keep clicking
All five fingers are still here

lines.zh: 一只手掌哪来的嘴，收回去。
lines.en: A hand has no mouth. Put it away.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西我拿不住
lines.en: I cannot grasp what you hold
I want only what moves
Raise it all you like, I have no mouth
It would fall between my bones
You had better keep it
I do not eat, I grab

lines.zh: 这个我一点兴趣也没有
lines.en: I have no interest in this
I try to pinch it
My fingers close on nothing
You strike my palm bone
The impact spreads my fingers
You slide back a step

lines.zh: 硬碰硬，碎的是你的肩膀。
lines.en: Bone against bone, and it is your shoulder that breaks.
The knock made me miss a grab
I close my fingers again

lines.zh: 撞了我一下还没倒，不错。
lines.en: You hit me and stayed standing. Good.
That tap was light
You burst out between my fingers
I turn my palm face up
I am only a hand
The rest of me is elsewhere

lines.zh: 骨头和骨头之间没什么可说的
lines.en: Bones have nothing to say to bones
I wait to grab something
I have no answer to that
I flex my fingers
I shake side to side, palm turning
I withdraw my hand

lines.zh: 我只有一半的身子在这里
lines.en: Only half of me is here
The other half hangs above

lines.zh: 两根指骨夹起它，悬在半空。
lines.en: Two finger bones pinch it up into the air.

lines.zh: 指骨一滑，它差点掉下去。
lines.en: It nearly slips out of my finger bones.
I squeeze and it crumbles
It slips between my fingers
I drop it on the ground
I turn my palm to look
I cannot hold anything this small
I sweep it aside
Two fingers cannot lift it
It rolls out of my palm
You are beneath my palm
My fingers are all spread
I will grab you in one motion
This time I close

lines.zh: 你退得再远，也在我的掌心里。
lines.en: However far you back off, you are still in my palm.
I turn my palm downward
My fingers are tightening
I press down slowly
This grab will not miss
I pin down where you stand

lines.zh: 你的影子在我的掌心里
lines.en: Your shadow lies in my palm
I am above your flank
All five fingers point at you
You are within my grasp

lines.zh: 影子罩住你时，我已经落下了。
lines.en: When my shadow covers you, I have already come down.
I have your landing worked out
This one finger moves first
I square my wrist
I need no help for this

lines.zh: 这一抓是为了把我拼齐
lines.en: This grab is to make me whole
I lower myself slowly
You shifted right just now
My finger bones point at you
I narrow the gaps between them
You mean to slip underneath

lines.zh: 你不停下，我就一直跟着。
lines.en: If you do not stop, I keep following.
My shadow already holds you
Do you hear my joints
I drop half a span nearer

lines.zh: 你转到哪，我的指节就对准哪。
lines.en: Wherever you turn, my knuckles point your way.
All of this lies under my palm
I close my fingers slowly
You are counting the steps left
I hold my wrist very low
You have little room left
My fingertips are nearly on you
I wait for your arms to fail
Jump, and I come down on you
The rattle of my bones grows near

lines.zh: 我把指缝收紧到一指宽
lines.en: I close the gaps to a finger width
My fingers close

lines.zh: 整只骨掌从上方盖下来。
lines.en: The whole bone palm comes down from above.
My knuckles crash on you
I clamp your waist
I lift you off the ground
My fingers rake your back
I snap my wrist
You are flung a few steps

lines.zh: 我抓空了，手指撞在地上
lines.en: I miss, and my fingers strike the earth
My hand opens again
My palm heel rams you
That one had weight behind it
I sweep you with the back of my fingers
My palm bone hits your shoulder
The ground splits open
A hand rises out of the earth
My finger bones come out first
I rise from under the shadow
Five fingers spread one by one
I turn my palm over
Dirt falls off my bones
A great hand hangs in the air
I work out from under the stones
I close my fingers as I land
Two fingers come up first
Clods slide off my palm
My knuckles extend one by one

lines.zh: 我悬在离地一格的地方
lines.en: I hang a block above the ground
The sound of a skeleton carries over
I drive my fingers into a crack
My palm faces the sky
A noise comes from the soil
I rear up like a pillar
My bones push the earth apart
Fire leaves a black mark on my palm
I hit the ground and bounce once

lines.zh: 水浸透了我空空的掌骨
lines.en: Water soaks into my hollow palm
The blast blows my fingers wide
An arrow jams between my bones

lines.zh: 咒光在我的关节里炸开
lines.en: Magic bursts inside my joints

lines.zh: 我没有肚子，所以不怕饿
lines.en: I have no belly, so hunger cannot reach me

lines.zh: 雷电在我五根手指间跳
lines.en: Lightning jumps between my five fingers

lines.zh: 下坠时我的手指还张着
lines.en: My fingers stay spread as I fall
